inputs.name: SocketFrameService.constructor.sockets
inputs.description: The adapter supplies each socket's attachment and sends the host-offline notice when a device packet cannot reach the host. It is used while processing incoming frames.

inputs.name: SocketFrameService.constructor.link
inputs.description: The link service drops sockets with close codes and attempts to deliver parsed device packets to the host. A failed delivery causes the socket adapter to send a host-offline notice.

inputs.name: SocketFrameService.constructor.commands
inputs.description: The command service handles text frames for sockets attached with the host role. It is called only after the frame passes the size and text checks.

inputs.name: SocketFrameService.message.socket
inputs.description: The WebSocket carrying the incoming frame and the key used to look up its attachment. A missing or closed attachment ends processing early, while device sockets also use it for per-socket rate counting.

inputs.name: SocketFrameService.message.message
inputs.description: Incoming WebSocket frame data. Frames over the size limit and non-text frames are dropped; host text is delegated to command handling, while device text must parse as a hello or sealed packet and pass the device rate limit.

inputs.name: SocketFrameService.closed.socket
inputs.description: The WebSocket reported as closed or failed. This operation asks the link service to drop it with close code 1000.

outputs.name: SocketFrameService.message
outputs.description: Returns a Promise<void> for processing the frame and produces no value on completion. It may return early for a missing or closed attachment, delegate a host text frame, drop invalid input, forward a validated device packet, or send a host-offline notice.

outputs.name: SocketFrameService.closed
outputs.description: Returns no value after asking the link service to drop the socket with close code 1000. It does not inspect or report the reason for closure.
